arcNotes: Opinion caller, warm and sincere. Vern shares Arecibo 1974 + the METI transmission debate + the century of accidental leakage, concedes her side half-wins, reframes readiness as not sounding scared. Hopeful close

lines.text: You'd make me argue against myself on my own show - and you nearly have. But I'll say the other half too, because somebody should: readiness isn't a vote, and a welcome from this frequency reaches one county, not one species. When the sky gives us something two radars agree on, that's when the world says hello - in one voice, not two hundred.
